poly_factor::equal_degree_factorization(f, d) over GF(q) by Cantor-Zassenhaus; g = x^q mod f is computed internally (MAGMA's third argument is not taken). The splitting loop certifies a block after 64 failed tries and panics after 256 more (probability <= 2^-256), and the field sampler is uniform. The ff_poly stack (cantor_zassenhaus::equal_degree_factorization, 7ce8117) and the i64 GF(p) path (fp_factor::equal_degree_factor, f0682b7; it gave up after 200 tries and returned the block unsplit) follow the same contract.
